# Databases {#databases}

We encourage researchers to access the SOGEDI Survey Database through the project’s official OSF repository at: [https://osf.io/sr2xq/](https://osf.io/sr2xq/). An additional version of this database is available via the project’s  [GitHub repository](https://github.com/sogedi-project/sogedi-data).
